# Planning components v2 — push to "best-in-class brainstorm tool"

Filemark today (2026-04-24) renders Chart, Kanban, Stats, ADR, Datagrid, Tasks (List/Stats/Kanban/Timeline) and a cross-file TaskPanel. Strong for *visualizing* plans; weaker on *generating* them. This doc enumerates what's missing to compete with Notion / Linear / Roam / Obsidian / Miro on the brainstorm + planning lane — without giving up the markdown-as-source-of-truth pitch.

- **Date opened:** 2026-04-24
- **Status:** ideation → first slice in build (M9)
- **Feeds into:** `TASKS.md` §M9 (each shipped item closes a task there)
- **Companion doc:** `PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` (v1 — already-shipped pillars)

---

## Pillar A — Visual / spatial thinking

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **MindMap** | Radial / horizontal tree from a markdown outline. Collapse / expand branches; click a node to open the source line. |
| **Whiteboard / StickyBoard** | Drag-able sticky notes from a CSV (`<StickyBoard src="./ideas.csv">`); group by colour or column. |
| **AffinityGrid** | Cluster sticky notes; auto-suggest cluster names. |
| **ConceptMap** | Network graph — nodes from headings, edges from inline `[[link]]`s. |
| **AnnotatedImage** | Hotspots on an image with markdown popovers. |

## Pillar B — Decision frameworks

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Matrix2x2** | Impact × Effort from CSV or `<Item>`. Items as draggable points (read-only on first pass). |
| **WeightedScore** | Options × criteria × weights → auto-ranked winner. |
| **DecisionTree** | Branching `<Branch if="…">`; auto-collapsed paths. |
| **DotVote** | Inline voting on options (persisted via StorageAdapter). |
| **FiveWhys** | Sequential `<Why>` blocks chaining root-cause analysis. |
| **PrioritizationGrid** | RICE / MoSCoW / Kano with auto-sort. |

## Pillar C — Time / sequencing

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Timeline** | Horizontal axis, lanes, zoom (already in v1 backlog). |
| **Gantt** | Date-range bars + deps + critical path. |
| **CalendarHeatmap** | GitHub-style activity grid. |
| **OKRtree** | Objective → Key Results → Tasks rollup; live progress % from `^task-…` ids. |
| **Roadmap** | Now / Next / Later columns from CSV with quarter headers. |
| **Burndown** | Auto-derived from `^task` completion dates. |

## Pillar D — Spec / decision authoring (templates)

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **PRFAQ** | Amazon press-release + FAQ template — title, sub-headline, summary, body, FAQ. |
| **RFC** | RFC template — Status, Context, Proposal, Alternatives, Risks, Decision. |
| **Pitch** | Shape Up template — Problem / Appetite / Solution / Rabbit holes / No-gos. |
| **PostMortem** | Incident timeline + 5 whys + action items. |
| **MeetingNotes** | One-shot capture: agenda → decisions → owners → due dates → auto-export to TaskList. |

## Pillar E — Knowledge connectivity (the moat plays)

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Backlinks** | Sidebar/footer panel — "what other docs link to this one". |
| **GraphView** | Force-directed graph of all `[[…]]` links in the library. |
| **TagExplorer** | All `#tag`s + count; click → list docs. |
| **Glossary** | `<Define term="…">` blocks auto-link every occurrence repo-wide. |
| **DocStatus** | `<DocStatus>` chip — Draft / Review / Approved + owner. Rollup at top of every dir index. |
| **SpecLinks** | Cross-doc relation chip — "blocks", "related to", "supersedes". Click-to-jump. |

## Pillar F — Live + AI-native (where filemark uniquely wins)

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **AIDraft** | `<AIDraft prompt="expand this into 3 bullets" />` — slot for local AI insertion. |
| **AIChip** | Highlight text → "ask AI to split into tasks" → writes back to doc. |
| **DailyNote** | Auto-creates today's note + rolls forward yesterday's open tasks (à la Roam). |
| **Watcher** | Auto-render `git log --since=1d` on a doc; live updating. |
| **VoiceCapture** | Press-to-talk → transcribe → markdown bullet (browser SpeechRecognition API). |

## Pillar G — Collaboration affordances

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Reactions** | 👍 ❤️ 🚀 buttons next to a paragraph; persisted via StorageAdapter. |
| **Annotations** | Hover-drag-select text → leaves an inline `<Note by="aman" date="…">`. |
| **ReadingTime** | `<ReadingTime>` chip auto-calculated from word count. |
| **TOCMini** | Floating mini-TOC (current section); pin as floating widget. |

## Pillar H — Polish gaps in existing components

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| **Stats variants** | `<Stat trend="…">` with sparkline inline. |
| **Chart annotations** | Vertical reference lines (release dates, milestones). |
| **Datagrid pivot** | Group rows by column → roll up sum / avg. |
| **Kanban WIP limits** | Column header shows `wip:3/5`; flag overflow. |
| **Task subtasks** | Indented `- [ ]` under a parent become nested progress (% done). |

---

## Tiered recommendation

### Tier 1 — first slice (this week, ≤ 1–2 days each)

The smallest set that *visibly* repositions filemark from "nice renderer" → "the place where planning lives." Build in this order so each lands clean.

| Order | Component | Why first |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **PRFAQ / RFC / Pitch templates** | Three structural docs founders/PMs adopt overnight; pure-MDX, zero infra. |
| 2 | **DocStatus chip** | One-line authoring + roll-up later. Visible signal across every doc. |
| 3 | **Backlinks panel** | Single biggest "knowledge tool" delta. Reuses `useTaskIndex` pattern → `useLinkIndex`. |
| 4 | **MindMap** | Visual punch; turns any outline into a brainstorm artefact. |
| 5 | **OKRtree** | Leverages already-shipped tasks DSL. Differentiator vs Linear/Notion. |
| 6 | **DailyNote workflow** | Roam-class daily template + auto-rollup. Glues everything together. |

### Tier 2 — power features (each ~2–3 days)

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Timeline** + **Gantt** | Carry-over from v1 backlog. |
| **Matrix2x2** | Impact × Effort prioritization. |
| **DecisionTree** | Branching analysis. |
| **GraphView** | All-doc force layout. |
| **WeightedScore** | Compact decision aid. |
| **PostMortem** + **MeetingNotes** | Rounds out Pillar D. |

### Tier 3 — niche / advanced

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Whiteboard / StickyBoard** | Drag canvas. |
| **CalendarHeatmap** | Streaks. |
| **Glossary** auto-link | Repo-wide hyperlinking. |
| **VoiceCapture** | Browser SpeechRecognition. |
| **AIChip / AIDraft** | Inline AI hooks. |
| **Reactions / Annotations** | Collab affordances. |
| Polish gaps in Pillar H | Incremental. |

---

## How to use this doc

- Add new ideas under the appropriate pillar.
- When a Tier 1 item is picked for build, copy the bullet into `TASKS.md` under `M9 — Planning v2 components` with full filemark sigils.
- When shipped: `[x]` here AND in `TASKS.md`; bump the "Tier 1" intro to reflect the new state.
- Prune Tier 3 items that haven't moved in 3 months.
